label: New York 13–21 UTC low swept
gloss: whether any price since the previous New York 13–21 UTC trading session closed has traded strictly below its low: swept, else intact — a touch is not a sweep; read live, because the last price decides; absent while that instance, any trading session since it, or the current one has no fold, or the last price is unknown

label: New York 13–21 UTC open (previous instance)
gloss: the opening print of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC), absent when that instance has no completed fold — never an older one

label: Supply zone average (prior New York 13–21 UTC)
gloss: the zone's midpoint — halfway between its inner edge and the window high, on the supply zone of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC): its range cut into 50 equal bins counted from the window high, each holding the volume of the 1m bars whose high lies in it, and the zone runs from the high to the first bin whose running share of the window's volume exceeds 10% — a BattleGrid variant of LuxAlgo “Supply and Demand Daily” (Intrabar TF 1m) over this session in place of the day; fixed once the window closes and absent until then; absent where the window has no range or no volume or no bin exceeds the threshold, and for a window that closed before these levels were first stored

supplyDemandThreshold.description: LuxAlgo’s Threshold %: the share of the window’s volume, counted in bins from its high (supply) or low (demand), a zone must exceed to end.

supplyDemandResolution.description: LuxAlgo’s Resolution: the equal bins the window’s range is cut into. Off its default the server rebuilds the window from its 1m bars, which reach only the last two UTC days.

label: Supply zone edge (prior New York 13–21 UTC)
gloss: the zone's inner edge — that bin's bound farther from the high, on the supply zone of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC): its range cut into 50 equal bins counted from the window high, each holding the volume of the 1m bars whose high lies in it, and the zone runs from the high to the first bin whose running share of the window's volume exceeds 10% — a BattleGrid variant of LuxAlgo “Supply and Demand Daily” (Intrabar TF 1m) over this session in place of the day; fixed once the window closes and absent until then; absent where the window has no range or no volume or no bin exceeds the threshold, and for a window that closed before these levels were first stored

supplyDemandThreshold.description: LuxAlgo’s Threshold %: the share of the window’s volume, counted in bins from its high (supply) or low (demand), a zone must exceed to end.

supplyDemandResolution.description: LuxAlgo’s Resolution: the equal bins the window’s range is cut into. Off its default the server rebuilds the window from its 1m bars, which reach only the last two UTC days.

label: Supply volume-weighted line (prior New York 13–21 UTC)
gloss: the zone's volume-weighted line — each of its bins' inner bounds weighted by the bin's volume, on the supply zone of the previous completed New York 13–21 UTC trading session (13:00–21:00 UTC): its range cut into 50 equal bins counted from the window high, each holding the volume of the 1m bars whose high lies in it, and the zone runs from the high to the first bin whose running share of the window's volume exceeds 10% — a BattleGrid variant of LuxAlgo “Supply and Demand Daily” (Intrabar TF 1m) over this session in place of the day; fixed once the window closes and absent until then; absent where the window has no range or no volume or no bin exceeds the threshold, and for a window that closed before these levels were first stored

supplyDemandThreshold.description: LuxAlgo’s Threshold %: the share of the window’s volume, counted in bins from its high (supply) or low (demand), a zone must exceed to end.

supplyDemandResolution.description: LuxAlgo’s Resolution: the equal bins the window’s range is cut into. Off its default the server rebuilds the window from its 1m bars, which reach only the last two UTC days.

label: Prior swing high (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the high of the decided swing high before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing high with

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Prior swing low (fractal 2/2)
gloss: the low of the decided swing low before the most recent one, while it is in reach — the pivot the structure label compares a swing low with

leftBars.description: Bars before a swing pivot it must be at least as extreme as.

rightBars.description: Closed bars after a swing pivot it must be strictly more extreme than; the pivot is decided on the last of them.

label: Initial balance high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the highest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

label: Initial balance low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lowest price of the previous completed UTC day's first 60 minutes

label: TPO point of control (prior UTC day)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time in the previous completed UTC day; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO profile shape (prior UTC day)
gloss: where the point of control sat inside the previous completed UTC day's value area, p-shape at or above 0.67 of its span and b-shape at or below the mirror

label: TPO value-area high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume point of control (prior UTC day)
gloss: the price bin that held the most typical-price-weighted volume in the previous completed UTC day; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area high (prior UTC day)
gloss: the upper edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Volume value-area low (prior UTC day)
gloss: the lower edge of the previous completed UTC day's 70% volume value area; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO point of control (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the price bin that held the most time of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area high (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the upper edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: TPO value-area low (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the lower edge of the 70% value area of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one; the level is the midpoint of a 5-bps price bin, so it is precise to that bin

label: Parabolic SAR
gloss: the parabolic SAR stop level (step 0.02, max 0.2)

accelerationStart.description: The Parabolic SAR’s acceleration factor at the start of each trend.

accelerationIncrement.description: How much the acceleration factor grows at each new extreme of the trend.

accelerationMaximum.description: The most the acceleration factor can grow to.

label: High (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the high of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: Low (previous week from Mon 00:00 UTC)
gloss: the low of the previous completed week from Mon 00:00 UTC, summed from its UTC days' profiles on one grid — absent when that instance has no completed composite, never an older one

label: QQE smoothed RSI
gloss: the QQE smoothed RSI — a 5-period EMA of RSI(14), on the 0–100 RSI scale

label: QQE trailing stop
gloss: the QQE trailing stop, on the same 0–100 scale as the smoothed RSI it brackets

label: Quote volume
gloss: the bar's traded notional, in USD: the sum of each trade's price × size from the live tape; absent for a bar holding a minute the live tape did not cover, never zero

label: Regime · conviction
gloss: how strongly the structure label holds: a trend’s tier moves with its volatility and its agreement with swing structure, a range’s with that agreement alone; never moved by a warning, and NOT how comfortably a gate cleared (the margins carry that)

label: Regime · crash latch
gloss: the crash latch is armed: set by a crash reading below the gate, cleared when the reading recovers to the exit gate — while armed the reading carries the crash warning

label: Regime · crash margin
gloss: standard deviations by which the crash reading — the fifteen-bar rate of change counted in the coin's own one-bar volatility before it — sits above the crash gate (-3) — how far the crash warning was from being raised

label: Regime · DI spread
gloss: DI+ − DI− in points on the regime timeframe — the value of the DIplus14_DIminus14_spread column read at the regime rung, not at a lower anchor — gated against the directional threshold (5)

label: Regime · momentum
gloss: the platform-classified momentum regime
